time_basis: DATE-AVG / MJD-AVG (mid-exposure) from the IMAGE header
wavelength_location: Spectral WCS (key W) sampled at the catalog-predicted position of Barnard's Star at this frame's mid-exposure time (native pixel x=28.96, y=28.77). Other pixels in the image record other wavelengths.

sampled_position.native_pixel_convention: 0-based FITS pixel centers of the IMAGE extension

registration.method_detail: Each display pixel takes the value of the native pixel containing its sky position, via the IMAGE TAN-SIP WCS. Pixels outside the image or non-finite are transparent.
registration.pixel_convention: origin at the top-left corner of the PNG, x right, y down, display pixels

notes: 3 of 21 screened pixels are non-finite (no usable value); the position is covered, so this is a quality problem, not missing coverage.
Informational flags present (not treated as problems): SOURCE.

display_scale.basis: Percentiles 1.0-99.5 of this frame's finite grid pixels. Brightness is not directly comparable between frames.
display_scale.clipping: values below low map to black, above high to white

marker.label: Catalog prediction (not a detection)
marker.source: SIMBAD via CDS Sesame (Gaia EDR3 (2020yCat.1350....0G)), propagated from epoch J2000.0 with catalog proper motion and parallax distance to this frame's mid-exposure time (annual parallax and binary orbits not modeled).

provenance.retrieved_at_basis: Download-ledger creation time (manifest.json created_utc); per-file retrieval time not recorded.
acknowledgments: This product uses data from SPHEREx, a NASA mission managed by the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, California Institute of Technology, obtained from the NASA/IPAC Infrared Science Archive (IRSA), operated by the California Institute of Technology under contract with NASA.

limitations: Display image is nearest-neighbour resampled from ~6.16 arcsec native pixels onto a 256x256 grid of 1.406 arcsec display pixels; it adds no resolution.
Pixels are contrast-stretched for viewing only; no background subtraction; not photometry.
Per-frame stretch: brightness is not directly comparable with other frames.
The quality screen checks flags in a small circle around one position. A clear result is not a detection.
The marker is a catalog prediction, not a position measured in this image.
